rationale: Ukraine air raid app hack creates direct security concern for Poland as neighbor; German cost-of-living protests signal spreading EU unrest; Kherson ceasefire ends with power cuts continuing regional instability.

top_events.title: Ukraine air raid app apparently hacked as users receive false radiation threat, Air Force says
top_events.label: Ukraine air raid app hacked with false radiation alert
top_events.summary: Cyberattack on Ukraine's emergency warning system creates confusion and panic near Poland's border, raising concerns about hybrid warfare spillover and information security in the region.

top_events.title: Shops looted as German cost-of-living protests turn violent
top_events.label: German cost-of-living protests turn violent with looting
top_events.summary: Violent protests spread to Germany after France, signaling deepening economic discontent across major EU economies that could affect Poland's regional stability and trade.

top_events.title: Russian strikes cut power to thousands in Ukraine as Kherson ceasefire ends
top_events.label: Russian strikes cut power as Kherson ceasefire ends
top_events.summary: Humanitarian pause expires with renewed infrastructure attacks in Ukraine, continuing energy warfare pattern that affects regional security and refugee flows toward Poland.

short_summary: German protests turn violent across major cities

most_significant_event.label: German protests turn violent across major cities
most_significant_event.summary: Violent protests erupted in Berlin, Hamburg, and Frankfurt over cost of living, mirroring unrest in France. Regional instability spreads to Poland's key EU neighbor and trade partner.
most_significant_event.title: Shops looted as German cost of living protests turn violent
